steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: These filthy rebels! They've been at this since Sudean!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Bring out that massive metal thing of yours!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You mean the self-propelled cannon? Sarkaz, there's still lots of our men up ahead!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Send them a signal.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ever heard of danger close? You know how wide its attack range is? They won't get away in time!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: That's their problem. Our warriors know how to survive on the battlefield.

spans.text: warriors know how to survive on the battlefield.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Over there—A movable mechanical Originium cannon!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What... What the hell is this? That's no normal artillery shell!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did Kazdel have some kind of advanced research institute I never heard of?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And in such a short time too... How did Manfred manage this?

options: Have you found the control area with your drones yet?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Control area... Control area... Crap, Doctor. These artillery shells've got Arts that jam my drones.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Like I said, Londinium's system is easy to crack, but Sarkaz witchcraft is tough!
Doctor, we'll take it from here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whoa, Feist!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Everything's set the way you wanted it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The engineering team will make sure your drones will fly free.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You've got an idea?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Closure, these Originium cannons were assembled in our factory.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So... You aren't planning on taking them apart right here and now, are you?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha, if we were Vampires, we definitely could've given it a shot.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Too bad, most of us are just normal craftsmen.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But we know what we've made with our own hands.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We know how to target their weak points to create an opening for our friends who can actually put up a fight.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: After all, this is how us engineers can put ourselves to use on the battlefield. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The zipline... You're gonna climb onto that?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Your drones will function as normal if we get the cannon under control, right?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: In theory. That's too risky, though...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're working together here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I need you and the Doctor to help us lock onto the safest landing point.
As the cannons echo in the air, Feist focuses on the battlefield before him.

He sees not the fierce Sarkaz, but the machinery by the conveyor belts he's the most familiar with. The thunderous sound of the enormous machine's movement is no different from the rhythms he knows so well.
He will take back the city that belongs to them, his own way.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Phew... I've always wanted to see a battle from up above. Isn't this the perfect chance?
The giant machine ambles down the street.
Compared to its colossal form, the men on the battlefield, be they Victorian or Sarkaz, are almost insignificant.
Its footsteps cannot be halted. Its gaze can easily melt the blocks.
It is practically the ruler of this steel jungle.
Yet it suddenly lets out a wail.
From a blind spot in its vision, a dozen grappling hooks latch onto the weakest point of its neck.
Immediately thereafter, several dozen figures climb onto its back via the zipline.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, we've got it under control!

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Casters, strike!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: On it!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Look at you, Banshee. You won't allow even a single drop of blood near you.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Every drop you control contains your witchcraft.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh ho ho. The curse of the Banshee.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Since when have the Banshees been as boring and uninteresting as you?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I still remember how they flew through the dark night, blowing their bone-whistles—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They mourned those lost to the wastelands with their sharp, sorrowful cries. At the same time, they mercilessly dug their pitch-black fingers into the skulls of those pitiful souls.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Banshee, that is what a Banshee is supposed to be.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They have always been the hunters that the Vampires admired the most. On the battlefield, we fought alongside one another with fear as our weapon, taking the lives of our feeble enemies.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But the Banshees of today have lost their way. Your kind has locked your true selves behind that attire not unlike what the Leithanian Casters wear. Decrepit and pretentious.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm afraid you are the one who's lost your way, Vampire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Time does more than relentlessly erode the lands. It shapes life as well.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Why not take a look at yourself? Your form has long since changed, you are no longer as you were.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hmph... What significance is the form my flesh takes?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Your flesh, like my robe, is the true form in which we walk the world.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The roots of Royal Court may have rotted away long ago, but Royal Court, as it stands today with its canopy raised up high, remains unwilling to fall to the ground.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: How pathetic... That which is dead continues to draw nutrients from the barren soil, denying itself the chance to receive new life.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: So this is your true goal?
The smile disappears from the Vampire's face. Next to him, the boiling blood settles into stasis for a brief moment.
A faint tremor can be felt beneath the ground, before the floor above it starts to shake as well.
Blood. Blood marches forward.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Operators, hold!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The battlefield below us...
He suddenly realizes he has stayed here for too long. Lettou is far from the only weak point in the command tower.

While both he and the Vampire had their attention drawn to the 'King of Sarkaz' and their old acquaintances, Rhodes Island and the Self-Salvation Corps have very likely been drawing ever closer to the information they need.
This was Rhodes Island's plan all along. They stood no chance of quickly defeating him and the Vampire. They simply wanted to buy themselves time.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I must...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You're too late.
Yes, he is. He can sacrifice an arm to escape from Ascalon, but the thing that's truly stopping him is the sea of blood before his eyes.
The Sanguinarch has already been angered. They are all trapped on this battlefield.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: ...Banshee.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You dare to plot the destruction of the Royal Court... the very manifestation of Sarkaz heritage?
An earth-shattering surge of blood envelops the entire command tower. The Rhodes Island Operators and the Defense Force soldiers are all moments away from being submerged.
That is, until a shapeless force divides this red sea of blood.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I do this not for destruction, but for my salvation.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Don't let your long memories bind you. Release yourself from your pride, from the olden days, Old Sarkaz King.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The Sarkaz have changed. The Sarkaz must change.
Under his bone pen, golden incantations write themselves loop by loop.
Heeding its master's rage, the pool of blood rises from the floor, the walls, and his head and charges toward the unapproachable young Banshee, as well as those he is shielding.
All because the Lord of Curses has already set the rules upon this high tower in a foreign land.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, the control tower...

options: I believe in Amiya, Logos, and Ascalon.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Phew... Looks like they managed to stall that scary guy...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, the drones have reached the control area.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Gonna start hacking now...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Half an hour... No, twenty minutes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, I know Amiya and the Corps guys are having a tough time right now... Trust me, I wish I had a couple more pairs of hands too!
The gigantic machine lets out another growl.
The previously silent cannon begins to rev up again.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What just happened?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The men on the cannon are under attack!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: There are hostiles in the distance...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It's the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: No idea what kind of Arts those Sarkaz are using!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: All of a sudden... I just couldn't breathe... I...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Confessarius witchcraft... These Sarkaz are their guards.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: When one has one's life depleted by this witchcraft so quickly, not even medical Arts can save them.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Have Feist evacuate the cannon surroundings with our fighters.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But then the weapon will go out of control again.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Our men's lives are precious.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I... will destroy the berserk weapon.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Commander, I'm feeling much better...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Commander, are these... your Arts?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: This light... is mobile.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Compared to mine... yes, it's much warmer.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: L-Look! Someone just appeared behind those Confessarius guards! Who's that?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: White horns, black robe... Is that... a Confessarius?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: The Confessarius... She's fighting the other Sarkaz!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor! That's—That's Shining!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did you ask her to come here?

options: Kal'tsit has kept in touch with her.
She's doing this of her own accord.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I knew how badass Shining could get, but this is my first time seeing her fight for real.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How do I put it? I... I...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm starting to understand why she avoids fighting so much.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Madam Confessarius...

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: You came to the fight after all. Once again, you went against our leader's will.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: If my actions are under his control, wouldn't that make my departure hardly meaningful?

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Do you really despise our leader so much?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I've never despised him. I've only ever despised myself.
The guard's mask splits, allowing his final expression before he succumbs to be reflected in the sheath of the Confessarius's sword.
Shining gazes at her opponent. Her eyes are both calm and sorrowful.
Once again, the final flicker of a living flame has been burned onto her blade forever.
The mist of blood is rapidly evaporating under the power of the witchcraft.
Countless beams of black energy are shot through the fissures torn open by the witchery.
The tides of blood that shroud the command tower have receded a little.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Your swordsmanship... Not bad.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Highness, we must finish this quickly.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Don't disturb me.
The blood's roar forces Manfred to take a few steps back.
Ascalon's armblade follows him closely. He knows she won't let him get away easily.
A red bolt of lightning flashes across the clouds above the command tower.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: This... The Teekazwurtzen.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Of course you'd know. Just as I know your armblade.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: A signal... You're contacting him.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Amiya, we don't have much time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, as long as we bring Lettou with us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nngh—!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Watch your defenses. The Vampire's power is far greater than this.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hm... What a waste of blood.
The battle before was far from enough to satisfy the Vampire.
He turns his attention to the Victorian soldiers hiding nearby.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What...! You... You can't...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: It'll be fine, Lettou. Soon enough, I shan't even need to keep you alive.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Lt. Colonel... Lt. Colonel!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ngah—!
The soldiers can no longer speak.
They fumble their way to the Vampire, as blood sprays out of their spines, one stream after another, heeding his orders in their arms and legs, marching forward rapidly.
They have received the Sanguinarch's blessing.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Do it. To your heart's content.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Blood doesn't dry simply because of death. It will only flow faster, thanks to your futile actions.
His soldiers no longer follow his commands.
He watches them advance and advance... until they reach the edge of the rooftop.
The Sarkaz's fight will soon destroy this place. Their eyes do not even see these normal soldiers who are in flux between life and death.
Most of the soldiers are Victorian. They are of entirely different upbringings than him. They remain oblivious to his objective and the deal he made with the Sarkaz to this very moment.
They simply followed him here... to the edge.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: *sigh*...
He knows he shouldn't have moved. The Vampire and Manfred would have been in no hurry to kill him as long as he hid in the far back.
But he still wanted to catch those soldiers about to fall to the depths below.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Black... energy beams... hah...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lt. Colonel Lettou.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can feel pain... in your eyes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You think of yourself a Gaulish man. You revere a massive phantom of the past. You want to take hold of it and bring it back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you really believe the Sarkaz's word? Do you really believe... that your dream to rebuild Gaul is possible?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You are afraid, sir.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You pretend you still have control... because you don't want to face the coward in you who wants to flee the war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You force yourself to believe that all the sacrifices you're making are for Gaul.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... you can't forget the eyes of those men you've deceived, who you called to their deaths.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: You... You are the young Lord of Fiends... they spoke of.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I am.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: And I am your enemy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: But... you held me back. You don't want to see me die here.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: They call you the Lord of Fiends... the King of Sarkaz... but all I see...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: ...is a kind, gentle girl.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nngh—!
An intense pain suddenly seizes her.
This isn't the doing of the Liberi before her, nor is it the Originium Arts of the Vampire or Manfred.
After all, this isn't an attack.
Amiya, oh Amiya.
A voice calls out to her. A voice as soft as a snow-white feather quilt that has been set out to dry in the sun.
Amiya lifts her head.
The sky above her comes smashing down. The thick dark clouds surge towards her, engulfing her from top to bottom.
...Like a tight, suffocating embrace.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, Commander, we've taken back control of the cannon!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ten minutes... Gimme just ten more minutes, and I'll take care of them all.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Phew... Doctor, for the first time these past few days, I think we just might be able to win this.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Closure...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I really wish you hadn't said that.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're thinking I must've jinxed... it... Holy shit, Doctor, what the hell's... My surveillance drones' alarms all started blaring at once!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Come on, say something. Going all quiet like that is really freaking me out!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait, that's—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Growls in warning)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She isn't buying us time... Uh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, you aren't trying to tell me... the Nachzehrer came back early, are you?
Their advance must have been silent. Otherwise, someone was sure to have noticed that they had broken through the walls and crossed half the city.
These footsteps are nothing but a signal that penetrates the hearts of all those on the battlefield through the trembling ground.
Every street their eyes can reach is filled with Sarkaz warriors.
The shadows cast by the dark clouds above cannot engulf them. After all, they are the dark shadows themselves. They are the ones who engulf the land.
